title: Endpoint Health & Digital Experience Monitoring
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (monitoring layer using Intune Endpoint analytics + optional DEX platforms; vendor specifics for Nexthink/Tanium deferred to vendor docs).
hook: See how every endpoint actually performs — before users call the help desk
problem: Most endpoint problems are invisible until a user complains: slow boots, app crashes, failing disks, battery wear, devices that never restart. By then the damage to productivity (and, in a clinical setting, to care) is done. This solution stands up endpoint health and digital experience monitoring using Microsoft Intune Endpoint analytics — startup performance, application reliability, resource and recommended-software scores — with an optional path to a dedicated digital-experience platform (such as Nexthink or Tanium) where deeper telemetry is required, so you find and fix degradations proactively.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — what endpoint health and digital experience monitoring is, the Intune Endpoint analytics model (startup, app reliability, work-from-anywhere, resource performance), proactive remediation, and where a dedicated DEX platform fits.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Endpoint analytics enablement, device data collection, optional DEX platform licensing, a baseline period) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing. Vendor-specific DEX setup is deferred to the vendor's documentation.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: enable Endpoint analytics, onboard devices, set baselines, interpret scores, wire proactive remediations for common issues, optionally integrate a DEX platform, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — monitoring-readiness discovery, device health/data-collection validation, a fleet health-score and issues report, safe remediation of common degradations, and a monitoring-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: Stand up endpoint health and digital experience monitoring with Intune Endpoint analytics (plus an optional DEX platform path) — startup, reliability, and resource scores that surface degradations before users call. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Stand up endpoint health and digital experience monitoring with Intune Endpoint analytics (plus an optional DEX platform path) — surface degradations before users call.
meta_description: Monitor endpoint health and digital experience with Intune Endpoint analytics: startup performance, app reliability, resource scores, proactive remediation, optional Nexthink/Tanium path. Self-guided, tested steps and scripts.
bottom_line: Proactive visibility into how every endpoint really performs — startup, reliability, and resource health scored and trending, common issues remediated automatically — proven on a pilot before you scale.

hero.tagline: FIND IT FIRST.  FIX IT QUIETLY.
